app.name: PS Package Pusher
banner.not_configured.text: Enter the console IP in Settings.
banner.not_configured.title: Console is not configured
console.bgft80990015.action: Delete the old download in Notifications → Downloads and try again. Versions before rc.5 leave it behind; rc.5 removes it itself after a failure.
console.bgft80990015.meaning: The console refused the install because an old failed download task for the same content is still registered.
console.bgft80990019.meaning: The console has no such download task any more (it was cancelled or removed).
console.bgft80991404.action: Use rc.4 or newer. If it appears again, attach the log.
console.bgft80991404.meaning: The console asked for the package URL and got 404. Before rc.4 the server did not ignore the query string of that URL.
console.ce30005.action: Check the package integrity and copy it again.
console.ce30005.meaning: Possible meaning: data read error, damaged package or disk.
console.ce32809.action: Check that the jailbreak is active.
console.ce32809.meaning: Possible meaning: the application cannot start (a consequence, not an install error).
console.ce36329.action: Run the jailbreak again, then RPI.
console.ce36329.meaning: Possible meaning: system error; with homebrew packages the jailbreak/install patch is often not active.
console.unknown.action: Search for the code and report it (attach the log).
console.unknown.meaning: The console reported code {code}; it is not in the catalog.
dialog.close.text: If you close the app, the console stops downloading after about 30 s.
dialog.close.title: Transfer in progress
dialog.error.title: Installation failed
dialog.installed.apply_all: Apply to all remaining packages in the queue
dialog.installed.reinstall_help: Reinstall = uninstall the existing game from the console, then install this package. Saved games should stay (not yet confirmed).
dialog.installed.text: {id} already exists on the console. Installing over it may cause a conflict.
dialog.installed.title: The game is already installed
dialog.installed.update_help: Install again = install this update once more, without uninstalling.
dialog.remove.title: Cancel the installation and remove it from the queue?
drop.title: Release to add to the queue
error.CFG-01.action: Enter the IP shown on the console screen (e.g. 192.168.1.50).
error.CFG-01.what: The value is not an IPv4 address. RPI 3.58 rejects host names.
error.CFG-01.why: RPI 3.58 accepts requests only on the console's IP address.
error.CFG-02.action: Enter your settings again. Please report the bug with the file attached.
error.CFG-02.what: A settings file was damaged. It was saved as {file} and defaults were loaded.
error.CFG-02.why: The file was cut off or edited by hand.
error.CFG-03.action: Title ID: 4 letters + 5 digits (CUSA12345). Content ID as shown on the package.
error.CFG-03.why: The value does not match the ID format.
error.FW-01.action: Allow the app in Windows Firewall (Private network), check that the network is Private, and turn off VPN or router AP isolation.
error.FW-01.what: The console accepted the install but never requested the file. It cannot reach this computer.
error.FW-01.why: Usually Windows Firewall, a Public network profile, a VPN or router AP isolation blocks the console.
error.FW-02.action: Click again and confirm, or use the Windows prompt.
error.FW-02.what: Nothing was changed: the Windows confirmation was declined.
error.FW-02.why: The UAC prompt was closed or declined.
error.FW-03.action: Allow the app manually (see the firewall guide).
error.FW-03.what: Windows did not accept the firewall rule: {detail}
error.FW-04.action: Contact your administrator or use another computer.
error.FW-04.what: This computer's firewall is managed by a policy (e.g. your company). Local rules have no effect.
error.FW-04.why: A group policy ignores firewall rules made on this computer.
error.NET-01.action: Check that the console is on, RPI is running, the IP is correct and both devices are on the same network.
error.NET-01.what: The console does not respond on {ip}:{port}.
error.NET-01.why: The console is off, RPI is not running, the IP changed or the devices are on different networks.
error.NET-02.action: Start RPI on the console. RPI 3.58 uses port 12801 (the old flatz version used 12800 and is not supported).
error.NET-02.what: The console is reachable, but RPI is not listening on port {port}.
error.NET-02.why: The console answered, but no program listens on that port.
error.NET-03.action: Use the IP address, not a name. Turn off proxy/VPN. Report a bug with the log if it keeps happening.
error.NET-03.why: RPI rejects requests that look like they come from a website (DNS rebinding protection).
error.NET-04.what: Something other than RPI is answering on that port.
error.NET-04.why: The answer was not RPI JSON.
error.NET-05.what: This RPI version does not have the expected endpoint.
error.NET-05.why: An older RPI version is running.
error.NET-06.action: Connect this computer to the same network, or enter the PC IP manually in Settings.
error.NET-06.what: This computer has no route to the console.
error.NET-06.why: No network interface leads to the console.
error.PKG-01.what: The file is not a PS4 package.
error.PKG-01.why: The file does not start with the PS4 package signature.
error.PKG-02.action: Recreate or copy the package again.
error.PKG-02.what: The package is damaged or incompletely downloaded.
error.PKG-02.why: Offsets in the header point outside the file.
error.PKG-03.what: param.sfo is missing or encrypted: name, version and type are unavailable.
error.PKG-03.why: Only the Content ID from the header is available.
error.PKG-04.action: Put all parts in the same folder.
error.PKG-04.why: All parts of a split package are needed.
error.PKG-05.what: This package is already in the queue (#{pos}).
error.PKG-05.why: The same Content ID, version and size are already in the queue.
error.PKG-06.action: Installing is possible at your own risk.
error.PKG-06.why: This category is not a game, update or DLC.
error.PKG-07.action: Remove the item and add it again.
error.PKG-07.what: The file changed or disappeared after it was added.
error.PKG-07.why: Size or modification time differ from when it was added.
error.RPI-01.action: See the console log in the details.
error.RPI-01.why: RPI checked the request and refused it.
error.RPI-02.action: Nothing is installed without this check. Try again.
error.RPI-02.what: Checking whether the title is installed failed.
error.RPI-02.why: The console did not answer the check.
error.RPI-04.action: See the code explanation and the console log.
error.RPI-04.why: The console's download service (BGFT) reported an error.
error.RPI-05.action: Check the console (rest mode, free space) and try again.
error.RPI-05.what: The transfer stopped (no progress for {secs} s).
error.RPI-05.why: The console or the network stopped sending progress.
error.RPI-06.action: Add and install the game before its update/DLC.
error.RPI-06.what: The base game {title_id} is not installed.
error.RPI-06.why: An update or DLC needs its game installed first.
error.RPI-07.action: Check the console. Try again resumes if possible.
error.RPI-07.what: The connection to the console was lost.
error.RPI-07.why: The console became unreachable or the app was closed during the transfer.
error.RPI-08.action: See the console log, or uninstall manually on the console.
error.RPI-08.what: Uninstall failed. With Reinstall, nothing was installed.
error.RPI-08.why: The console refused or did not finish the uninstall.
error.SRV-01.action: Choose another port in Settings (a free one is suggested).
error.SRV-01.what: Port {port} is used by another program.
error.SRV-01.why: Two programs cannot listen on the same port.
error.SRV-02.action: Run the connection test and try again.
error.SRV-02.why: The network changed (e.g. DHCP gave a new address).
error.SRV-03.action: Restore the file or disk, or remove the item and add it again.
error.SRV-03.what: The file was moved, deleted or its disk disconnected while sending.
error.SRV-03.why: The console downloads in parts and needs the same file until the end.
error.SRV-04.action: Copy the package to a local SSD/HDD.
error.SRV-04.what: Reading from disk is very slow. The console aborts after 30 s of waiting.
error.SRV-04.why: The disk is slow, sleeping or on the network.
firewall.dialog.self: Or let the app do it: Windows asks for confirmation (UAC); the rule allows only port {port}, Private network and the local subnet.
firewall.dialog.step1: 1. When Windows shows "Windows Security Alert" for PS Package Pusher, tick "Private networks" and click "Allow access".
firewall.dialog.step2: 2. The network of the computer and the console must be "Private" (Settings → Network & internet).
firewall.dialog.step3: 3. If you clicked "Cancel" before, or Windows never asks, use the button below.
firewall.dialog.step4: 4. A VPN or router "AP/client isolation" can also block the connection.
firewall.dialog.text: The console downloads packages directly from this computer (port {port}). Windows Firewall blocks that by default.
firewall.dialog.title: Allow the console to reach this computer
firewall.label: Windows Firewall
firewall.policy: Managed by a policy: local rules have no effect
queue.empty.hint: or use Add files / Add folder (Ctrl+O)
queue.empty.text: Games, updates and DLC. Split packages are joined automatically.
queue.empty.title: Drop .pkg files or folders here
settings.busy: Not available while a transfer is running.
settings.err.hostname: Enter an IP address, not a name (RPI 3.58 rejects names because of DNS rebinding protection).
settings.err.ip_unicast: This address cannot be a console (0.0.0.0, broadcast or multicast).
settings.title: Settings
settings.warn.low_port: Ports below 1024 may need admin rights.
splash.step.port_busy: The local server port is in use (SRV-01)
test.firewall: The firewall is confirmed on the first transfer.
test.log_old: Older RPI: no console log; 3.58 recommended
test.subnet_warn: This computer and the console look like different networks ({pc} / {console})
uninstall.busy: This title is being installed right now.
uninstall.text.dlc: The add-on will be deleted; the game stays. This cannot be undone.
uninstall.text.game: The game will be deleted from the console. Saved games should stay (not yet confirmed). This cannot be undone.
uninstall.text.patch: The update will be deleted; the game goes back to its base version. This cannot be undone.
uninstall.title: Uninstall from the console?
